name: L2 Window and loop
body: Port `sdl-facade`, `InputRouter` and `FrameLoop`, run against a stub game.

comments.text: Ported on the L2 PR: InputRouter and FrameLoop with the 13 Rust tests, sdl-facade (context, window, platform, event translation, audio output) with two SDL test programs, and a stub game. 42 of 42 test programs pass on the native and C backends. tools/check-window.sh runs the stub game under Xvfb and openbox and checks it resized, minimised (no renders or steps while minimised), restored and quit; Escape and closing the window both quit. The stub SDL in the acceptance criteria is SDL's real x11 driver on Xvfb, since the offscreen driver doesn't minimise. Mac check still to do by Dean. Nox gaps found, on the Nox board under proto-lantern-engine-on-nox: proto-parsing-numbers-from-text, proto-when-arms-on-named-integer-constants, proto-an-owned-string-from-a-literal, proto-sleeping-the-current-thread.

acceptance_criteria.text: A window that resizes, minimises and quits cleanly
Input edges latch as Lantern documents
Checked against the stub SDL in cloud sessions

definition_of_done.text: PR into `nox-proto`, reviewed, with the milestone's checks passing
